params.message:
Free photo name asks the bucket for a file, never a directory

PhotoNames::free checked names with Storage::exists(), which on S3 is a
HEAD and then a ListObjectsV2 over the name. The listing failed for
24182/stocklist_car_image_7.jpg and the request threw
UnableToCheckDirectoryExistence. It now asks fileExists() through
StorageUnavailable::retryPastThrottle, like the partner path's other
bucket questions. The R S1-6.38 guard test also catches a disk passed
in as a variable, which is how this call slipped past it.

Nightwatch: 79
